title: Academic and professional
blurb: The expensive end: research monographs, journals and reference works, usually bought by a library rather than a person.

items.d: Technical books and live training, priced for employers more than individuals.
Scientific monographs and journals, with open-access titles mixed in.

Computer-science papers and proceedings, some of them open.
